entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-05-21
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [LSP] [textDocument/rename] issue with source generated files #83826
  • Prevent helix partitioning from creating hundreds of work items items when no history available #83824
  • C# Quick Info hides XML doc `<param>` details on method hover #83819
  • Double include confuses Visual Studio #83818

Closed

  • Page missing for CS8997 #77360
  • NullReferenceException for required field backed property and SetsRequiredMembersAttribute in derived class #83816

  • Rationalize the different command lines for RunTests #83827
    Area-Infrastructure

  • Remove catch from FBA fuzz test #83820
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode

    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions

    Area-Infrastructure, Needs API Review, Area-Razor
